# IWMMD 1.3.0

IWMMD 1.3.0 adds an opt-in public demo mode with disposable mock data, anonymous read-write access, and automatic resets.

## Public demo mode

- Enable with `IWMMD_DEMO_MODE=true`.
- Set the anonymous role with `IWMMD_DEMO_ROLE=member` or `admin`. The default is `member`.
- Set the reset interval with `IWMMD_DEMO_RESET_INTERVAL`. The default is `30m`, with a minimum of `1m`.
- Requests use a seeded demo identity, so OIDC discovery and login are skipped only while demo mode is enabled.
- Mutations still require the per-process CSRF token.
- Sign-out is hidden in the interface and demo mode is shown in the header and Settings.

Start a local demo with Compose:

```sh
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.demo.yaml up -d
```

## Disposable data

- Demo mode seeds domains, checks, incidents, alert rules, channels, notifications, audit entries, and settings.
- A `demo.marker` setting identifies the database as disposable.
- Startup refuses a non-empty data directory without the marker, which prevents accidental use against real data.
- A background loop replaces all demo content on the configured interval.
- The bundled `compose.demo.yaml` overlay uses a separate data volume and enables demo mode.
- Demo mode has no database migration.

## Simulated outbound activity

- Domain checks use a deterministic in-process checker. No DNS, RDAP, or WHOIS requests are made.
- Email, webhook, Discord, Telegram, and test deliveries return success without opening network connections.
- Unknown demo domains receive stable fake expiry dates. Names containing `broken` or `fail` simulate lookup failures.
- `acme-demo.net` demonstrates an unsupported expiry source.

## Safety notes

- Use a separate empty data directory or Compose volume. Never enable demo mode on real data.
- Put a reverse proxy in front for TLS, request limits, and rate limiting. Do not expose the Go server directly to the internet.
- Treat all demo changes as public and temporary.

## Upgrade from 1.2.0

There is no database migration. Stop IWMMD, replace the container image or binary, and start it again.

Existing deployments remain OIDC-only unless `IWMMD_DEMO_MODE=true` is explicitly set.

Container users:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.3.0
```

Set `IWMMD_IMAGE=ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.3.0` in `.env` to pin the release.

Binary users:

```sh
curl -LO https://github.com/MrWeez/iwmmd/releases/download/v1.3.0/iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_amd64/iwmmd /usr/local/bin/iwmmd
iwmmd version
```

Replace `amd64` with `arm64` on ARM servers.

## Release assets

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_amd64` | Raw static binary for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_arm64` | Raw static binary for ARM64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.3.0_linux_arm64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for ARM64 Linux |
| `checksums.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for all binary assets |

Verify downloaded assets:

```sh
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing checksums.txt
```

## Container image

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.3.0
```

Published image tags: `1.3.0`, `1.3`, `1`, `latest`, and `sha-<commit>`.
